issue.body:
## Outcome

Produce one reviewed Observatory experience-design contract.

## Primary deliverable

One reviewed Observatory design contract covering information, interaction, states, hierarchy, and accessibility.

## Verification result

Information-contract, state-matrix, accessibility, and Runtime-field-census checks pass without invented authority.

## Unit boundary

Issue completion is exactly acceptance of one Observatory experience-design contract; view and accessibility checks are evidence inputs.

## Dependencies

- None.

## Retained predecessor scope

- None; this is new v0.92.1 work.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every view has a stable information contract
- [ ] Empty degraded recovery and revoked states are designed
- [ ] Keyboard and screen-reader flows are specified
- [ ] No invented Runtime field is introduced

## Owned paths

- `demos/html-observatory/design/**`
- `docs/observatory/**`
- `docs/milestones/v0.92.1/evidence/observatory/obs-a/**`

## PVF lanes

- `information-contract`
- `state-matrix`
- `accessibility-plan`
- `runtime-field-census`

## Stop conditions

- A design requires unavailable Runtime authority
- Accessibility denominator is incomplete

## Non-goals

- Production implementation
- Unity TLS work

## Canonical planning identity

- Planned ID: `OBS-A`
